decision.explanation: All three answers are supported by direct evidence from the provided sources. 'Member of the Bundestag' is supported by D1S2 and D2S9. 'Representative of his constituency' is supported by D1S4. 'President of El Salvador' is explicitly stated in D2S2. These positions are attributed to the same referent (Peter Röhlinger) across different documents and are not mutually exclusive. There is no evidence of contradiction or invalidation among these claims.
